2.15.14
Subreport.Top
The Subreport.Top element specifies the distance of the subreport from the top of the subreport’s
container, such as a Rectangle or Body. This element is optional. If this element is present, its value
MUST be an RdlSize.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.Top element.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.Top element.
 <xsd:element name="Top" type="SizeType" minOccurs="0" />
